test_title: PYST 6: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

she had no ________ of telling him the truth.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e. **'intention'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is looking for a **noun** to fill the blank. 
 
• **In this context, **where we are discussing someone's plan or resolve to do something. 
 
• The correct word to use is **'intention'. **

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is *"She had no **intention** of telling him the truth."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Option 1'** i.e. 'intending' and **'Option 2' **i.e. 'intended' are verbs and not suitable to complete the sentence.
 
• **'Option 3' **i.e. 'intents' is a noun but it does not fit correctly into the sentence. 'Intention' is a more appropriate word to use in this context.
